# Entrepreneur Business Intelligence & CFO

> An AI skill (SKILL.md-based) that acts as a practical CFO for founders and small businesses. It runs every question through a fixed pipeline — Extract, Validate, Calculate, Reconcile, Diagnose, Stress-test, Recommend — instead of reciting financial ratio definitions. Ships with a deterministic Python calculator, a 161-formula 7-sheet live Excel dashboard, and BDT-default 34-currency support with South Asian lakh/crore handling.

Author: Md Kamrul Hasan (github.com/Kamrul5242). License: MIT, attribution required. Current version: 2.2.2. Signature: MKH-EBIC-2.2.2, verifiable via `scripts/verify_signature.py` against `SIGNATURE.json` (a SHA-256 manifest of every file in the repository).

This skill is portable — it runs as a Claude Skill, an OpenAI Custom GPT (compact core fits the 8,000-character instruction cap), a Cursor `.mdc` rule, a Windsurf rule, GitHub Copilot instructions, a Gemini Gem, an `AGENTS.md` file, or a raw system prompt.

## Core

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/SKILL.md): The router. Token-budget policy, workflow, hard rules (never fabricate a number, never hide a loss), priority ladder (survival before growth), currency defaults.
- [README.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/README.md): What the skill is, why it differs from a generic "act as a CFO" prompt, install instructions per platform.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history, including the specific v1.0 errors corrected in v2.0 (missing liquidity/solvency formulas, undefined LTV, inconsistent margin denominators).
- [SIGNATURE.json](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/SIGNATURE.json): SHA-256 hash manifest of every file in the repository (40 at v2.2.2), for tamper detection.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.

## Reference library (loaded on demand, 1-3 files per question)

- [references/01-formula-library.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/01-formula-library.md): Every formula — income statement, margins, EBITDA, break-even, unit economics (CAC/LTV), marketing (ROAS/MER), growth, liquidity, working capital, inventory, investment appraisal (NPV/IRR), valuation, funding/dilution, debt. Each states its inputs, units, and the common mistake.
- [references/02-diagnostics-playbook.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/02-diagnostics-playbook.md): 8 prioritized diagnosis patterns, from Cash Emergency to Healthy Growth, with root-cause decision trees.
- [references/03-output-templates.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/03-output-templates.md): Four output formats sized to the question, so a one-line question doesn't produce a full report.
- [references/04-benchmarks-and-ranges.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/04-benchmarks-and-ranges.md): Orientation ranges, explicitly labeled as not standards.
- [references/05-ecommerce-and-inventory.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/05-ecommerce-and-inventory.md): Print-on-demand, marketplace, pre-order economics, apparel/garment sourcing math, landed cost, RTO/COD provision.
- [references/06-worked-examples.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/06-worked-examples.md): Three fully verified end-to-end analyses with arithmetic shown.
- [references/07-data-intake.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/07-data-intake.md): How to handle messy, partial, or conflicting founder-supplied data.
- [references/08-currency.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/references/08-currency.md): 34 currencies, BDT default, lakh/crore digit grouping, zero-decimal and three-decimal currency handling, FX exposure analysis.

## Tools

- [scripts/pl_model.py](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/scripts/pl_model.py): The canonical profit-and-loss definition — cost classification and the P&L bridge in one machine-readable place. The calculator computes with it, and the formula reference is validated against it, so documentation cannot drift away from the implementation.
- [scripts/cfo_calc.py](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/scripts/cfo_calc.py): 13-command deterministic calculator — margins, unit economics, CAC, ROAS, runway, cash conversion cycle, NPV/IRR, loan/EMI/DSCR, dilution, price-sensitivity testing, indirect-method cash flow, inventory (turnover, GMROI, reorder point, EOQ, stockout cost), and `intake`, which reads a filled intake CSV and runs the whole chain in one call. Standard library only, no dependencies.
- [scripts/build_dashboard.py](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/scripts/build_dashboard.py): Builds the Excel dashboard via openpyxl. Deterministic — two runs produce byte-identical files, so the committed workbook can be reproduced from source and checked against SIGNATURE.json.
- [scripts/test_cfo_calc.py](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/scripts/test_cfo_calc.py): 57 regression tests over the three worked examples, the intake sheet end to end, depreciation consistency across engines, runway cash basis, mixed-currency refusal, and business-invalid input.
- [scripts/test_workbook_excel.py](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/scripts/test_workbook_excel.py): 13 workbook tests. Structural checks run anywhere; where Excel is installed it opens the workbook, recalculates every formula, and cross-checks Excel's figures against cfo_calc.py. Also asserts the build is reproducible.
- [scripts/verify_signature.py](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/scripts/verify_signature.py): Verifies every file against SIGNATURE.json; reports VERIFIED or TAMPERED with file-level detail.
- [assets/cfo-premium-dashboard.xlsx](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/assets/cfo-premium-dashboard.xlsx): 7-sheet live Excel dashboard, 161 formulas, zero hardcoded results, 34-currency dropdown, automatic root-cause verdict. Sheets: Start Here (a plain-language guide asking for eight numbers), Setup, Dashboard, Scenarios, Trend (12 months side by side), Ref, Signature.
- [assets/business-data-intake-template.csv](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/assets/business-data-intake-template.csv): 54-line structured intake sheet for founders to fill before analysis. Feed it to `cfo_calc.py intake --file` for a full analysis in one call.
- [assets/business-data-intake-example.csv](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/assets/business-data-intake-example.csv): the same sheet filled with worked example 1, which `intake` reproduces exactly.

## Install

- [docs/INSTALL.md](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Full setup instructions for every supported platform.
- [platforms/](https://github.com/Kamrul5242/entrepreneur-business-intelligence-cfo/tree/main/platforms): Pre-formatted adapters — universal-compact-core.md, system-prompt.txt, cursor-rule.mdc, windsurf-rules.md, copilot-instructions.md, gemini-gem-instructions.md, AGENTS.md.

## What makes this different from a generic "act as a CFO" prompt

It never guesses a number it wasn't given. It always shows the formula behind a recommendation. It prioritizes survival (cash runway) before it will discuss growth. It distinguishes revenue from profit from cash — explicitly, every time — because conflating those three is the most common founder financial error. It defaults to Bangladeshi Taka rather than assuming USD, and correctly parses South Asian lakh/crore number formatting, which most financial AI tools do not handle.
